grammar.q: For most listeners, following a single melody that develops gradually is far easier than [ ____ ] track of several contrasting rhythms at once. NEW
During a strong storm, the pressure on the front face of a tall building is usually much greater than [ ____ ] on its back face. NEW
The curators cleaned the damaged paintings, photographed their surfaces, and [ ____ ] them in a room with controlled temperature.
Some critics argue that reading a novel in translation is just as valuable as [ ____ ] it in its original language.
[ ____ ] the treaty was signed by both governments in 1921, it was never fully enforced along the disputed border.
The board of directors has not yet decided [ ____ ] to expand the factory overseas or to invest in new technology at home.
The ferry service was suspended for three days [ ____ ] the storm that severely damaged the harbor’s infrastructure.
Neither the mayor nor the council members [ ____ ] willing to comment on the leaked report.
Many visitors are surprised to learn [ ____ ] the seemingly unified cathedral was actually built over three centuries.
Learning to tolerate uncertainty is often more important for young scientists than [ ____ ] every formula in their textbooks.
[ ____ ] the delegates were arguing over the final statement, hundreds of protesters gathered outside.
The rumor [ ____ ] the company would close its largest factory, which employed nearly half of the town’s workers, spread quickly, although no official announcement had yet been made.
The new guidelines require researchers to store their data securely, share it with other teams on request, and [ ____ ] any errors promptly.
The winters in this northern province are far harsher than [ ____ ] in the southern coastal cities, where snow rarely falls and the rivers almost never freeze.

After the floods, the volunteers repaired the damaged school buildings, distributed textbooks to the children in the surrounding villages, and [ ____ ] local teachers to use the new digital equipment donated by the government.
The workshop helps young entrepreneurs identify potential investors and [ ____ ] their business plans with confidence.
Many commuters prefer cycling to work along the river to [ ____ ] in traffic jams on the congested highway for more than an hour.
The lecture on quantum physics was [ ____ ] abstract that even the graduate students struggled to follow the argument.
[ ____ ] its strategic location between two major trade routes, the small port city prospered for centuries while its neighbors declined.
[ ____ ] the documentary was criticized for oversimplifying the history of the conflict, it won several awards at international film festivals.
Several delegates fell asleep [ ____ ] the lengthy speech on the economic consequences of the trade agreement.
Passengers are asked to remain seated with their seat belts fastened [ ____ ] the aircraft is taxiing toward the terminal after landing.
The historian was fascinated by the fact [ ____ ] the two rival kings, who had fought three bloody wars against each other, had secretly exchanged letters for nearly a decade.
[ ____ ] the archaeologists found beneath the temple was a sealed chamber containing hundreds of clay tablets.
Experts disagree about [ ____ ] the new rules will reduce emissions or simply relocate polluting industries.
The journalist asked the minister [ ____ ] the government had been warned before the dam collapsed.
Either the director or her assistants [ ____ ] expected to testify at the hearing about the missing funds.
The new electric car is not only remarkably quiet but also [ ____ ] to maintain over many years.
She devoted her retirement to translating ancient poems, restoring damaged manuscripts, and [ ____ ] calligraphy to children in her village.
The annual rainfall in the eastern highlands is nearly three times as high as [ ____ ] in the western plains.
At the end of the two-hour interview, the panel asked the candidate [ ____ ] she considered the greatest weakness of her own published research.
It was [ ____ ] a severe drought that the authorities rationed drinking water for the first time in decades.
[ ____ ] the film festival will continue or not depends largely on the generosity of private donors.
The exchange program allows students to spend a semester overseas and [ ____ ] the credits they earn to their home university.
Saving small amounts regularly is often more effective than [ ____ ] a large sum in risky stocks.
The museum closed its doors to the public [ ____ ] its roof had weakened so badly that it could no longer bear heavy snow.
[ ____ ] the lack of reliable evidence, the theory gained widespread acceptance among nineteenth-century scholars.

Psychologists have long argued [ ____ ] the way parents respond to their children’s failures, whether with patience or with anger, strongly shapes how those children approach challenges and setbacks later in life.
The future of the project depends on [ ____ ] the town can afford to rebuild the old bridge or must construct a new one elsewhere.
Both the director of the museum and the head of the restoration team [ ____ ] present when the stolen painting was returned from Paris.

arrange.ko: 그 연구팀은 그 화석을 발견했을 뿐만 아니라 그것이 어느 시대의 것인지도 정확히 밝혀냈다.
arrange.bogi: but also / identify exactly which period it belonged to / not only / the research team / discovered the fossil
arrange.ans: The research team not only discovered the fossil but also identified exactly which period it belonged to.

arrange.ko: 새 재활용 계획이 성공할지는 지역 주민들이 그것을 기꺼이 지지하려 하는지에 크게 달려 있다.
arrange.bogi: whether local residents / depends largely on / be willing to support it / whether the new recycling plan will succeed
arrange.ans: Whether the new recycling plan will succeed depends largely on whether local residents are willing to support it.

arrange.ko: 정부가 이끈 몇 달간의 협상에도 불구하고, 두 항공사는 합병 조건에 합의하지 못했다.
arrange.bogi: the two airlines / months of negotiations led by the government, / despite / on the terms of their merger / failed to agree
arrange.ans: Despite months of negotiations led by the government, the two airlines failed to agree on the terms of their merger.

arrange.ko: 새 출근 규칙은 시간제 근로자들에게 공정하지 않으며, 대부분의 관리자들이 실제로 지키지도 않을 것이다.
arrange.bogi: will it / is not fair to part-time workers, / actually be followed by most managers. / the new attendance rule / nor
arrange.ans: The new attendance rule is not fair to part-time workers, nor will it actually be followed by most managers.

arrange.ko: 마침내 전쟁에 대한 여론을 바꾼 것은 통계가 아니라 바로 울고 있는 아이를 찍은 그 한 장의 사진이었다.
arrange.bogi: that / not the statistics, / it was / finally change public opinion about the war. / that single photograph of a crying child,
arrange.ans: It was that single photograph of a crying child, not the statistics, that finally changed public opinion about the war.

arrange.ko: 손상으로부터 연약한 그림들을 보호하기 위해, 그 박물관은 전시실의 온도를 20도 아래로 유지한다.
arrange.bogi: the museum / below twenty degrees. / keep the temperature in the gallery / the fragile paintings from damage, / to protect
arrange.ans: To protect the fragile paintings from damage, the museum keeps the temperature in the gallery below twenty degrees.

arrange.ko: 그 마을에는 오래된 돌우물이 하나 있는데, 주민들은 매일 저녁 소식을 나누려고 그 둘레에 모인다.
arrange.bogi: gather every evening to share news. / which / the village has an old stone well, / the residents / around
arrange.ans: The village has an old stone well, around which the residents gather every evening to share news.

arrange.ko: McNeil과 Duncan은 제스처가 화자에게 그러한 선택을 제시하지 않는다는 점에서 언어와 다르다고 주장한다.
arrange.bogi: in that / McNeil and Duncan argue / it does not present the speaker with such choices. / that gesture / differ from language
arrange.ans: McNeil and Duncan argue that gesture differs from language in that it does not present the speaker with such choices.

arrange.ko: 인간은 빨간색을 가지고 최초의 색채 실험을 했을 뿐만 아니라 그것으로 최초의 성공도 거두었다.
arrange.bogi: achieved their first successes with it. / not only did their first color experiments with red / humans / but also
arrange.ans: Humans not only did their first color experiments with red but also achieved their first successes with it.

arrange.ko: 지식 공동체의 기술은 너무 복잡해서 대부분의 외부인은 여러 해의 훈련 없이는 그것을 이해할 수 없다.
arrange.bogi: without many years of training. / that most outsiders cannot understand them / the skills of an epistemic community / are so complex
arrange.ans: The skills of an epistemic community are so complex that most outsiders cannot understand them without many years of training.

arrange.ko: 그 프로그램은 학생들이 지역 문제를 조사하고, 해결책을 제안하고, 그 결과를 시의회에 발표하도록 돕는다.
arrange.bogi: present the results to the city council. / helps students / propose solutions, and / investigate local problems, / the program
arrange.ans: The program helps students investigate local problems, propose solutions, and present the results to the city council.

translate.en: In this view, speech and gesture are not redundant nor is one a “translation” of the other.
translate.ko: 이러한 관점에서, 말과 제스처는 중복되는 것이 아니며 어느 하나가 다른 하나의 ‘번역’도 아니다.

translate.en: It was with red that humans did their first color experiments, achieved their first successes, and then constructed a chromatic universe.
translate.ko: 인간이 최초의 색채 실험을 하고, 최초의 성공을 거두며, 그다음 색채의 세계를 구축했던 것은 바로 빨간색을 가지고서였다.

translate.en: To minimize vortex shedding, skyscraper designers do everything in their powers to confuse the wind.
translate.ko: 회오리바람 발생을 최소화하기 위해, 초고층 빌딩 설계자들은 바람을 교란시키려고 그들의 힘이 닿는 한 모든 것을 다한다.

translate.en: To acquire expert knowledge, one needs to become a member of the relevant group of knowledge bearers, for which I will use the term “epistemic communities.”
translate.ko: 전문 지식을 얻으려면 관련 지식 보유자 집단의 구성원이 되어야 하는데, 그것에 대해 나는 ‘지식 공동체’라는 용어를 쓰겠다.

translate.en: Regardless of musical style, an increase of focus on certain parameters in a musical passage should be accompanied by a decrease in focus on others.
translate.ko: 음악 양식과 상관없이, 한 악절에서 특정 요소에 대한 집중이 늘어나면 다른 요소에 대한 집중은 그만큼 줄어야 한다.

translate.en: The human mind has an attention limit, beyond which music is most likely to be perceived as lacking order or direction.
translate.ko: 인간의 정신에는 주의력의 한계가 있으며, 그 한계를 넘으면 음악은 질서나 방향성이 없는 것으로 인식될 가능성이 매우 높다.

translate.en: For instance, if the intention is to focus on melodic lines, then one should avoid making too many contrasting timbre variations while the melodies are unfolding; otherwise, the timbre may distract attention away from the pitch.
translate.ko: 예를 들어, 의도가 선율에 집중하는 것이라면, 선율이 전개되는 동안 대조되는 음색 변화를 너무 많이 만드는 것을 피해야 하는데, 그렇지 않으면 음색이 음높이로부터 주의를 딴 데로 돌릴 수 있다.

translate.en: One of the most difficult issues in the practice of composition is to find the right balance between repetition and diversity: a well-balanced piece of music should unfold naturally to listeners.
translate.ko: 작곡 실무에서 가장 어려운 문제 중 하나는 반복과 다양성 사이의 적절한 균형을 찾는 것인데, 균형이 잘 잡힌 음악 한 곡은 듣는 사람에게 자연스럽게 전개되어야 한다.

translate.en: In most Western musical styles, this unfolding results from a network of relationships between musical attributes that combine in different ways to create situations where contrasts can take place.
translate.ko: 대부분의 서양 음악 양식에서, 이러한 전개는 대조가 일어날 수 있는 상황을 만들어 내기 위해 여러 방식으로 결합하는 음악적 속성들 사이의 관계망에서 비롯된다.

translate.en: Such contrasts are normally preceded by a preparatory stage, which builds upon the listener’s expectations.
translate.ko: 그러한 대조 전에는 보통 준비 단계가 오는데, 그것은 듣는 사람의 기대를 바탕으로 한다.
